scripts.build: pnpm run check:types && pnpm --filter desktop run build
scripts.check:dependencies: mise exec -- cargo deny --manifest-path Cargo.toml check
scripts.check: pnpm run check:icons && pnpm run build && pnpm run check:rust
scripts.verify: pnpm run verify:portable && pnpm run verify:native
scripts.verify:native: pnpm run check:rust && mise exec -- cargo clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -- -D warnings && mise exec -- cargo test --locked --workspace && pnpm run check:dependencies
scripts.verify:portable: pnpm run check:identity && pnpm run check:terminology && pnpm run check:publication && pnpm run check:language && pnpm run check:quality && pnpm run check:icons && pnpm run build && pnpm test
